items.title: OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List — machine-readable
items.content_text: The U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN list parsed into JSON and CSV: 19,254 designated entries and 20,350 alternate identities, each with its OFAC uid, entity type and sanctions programs. Public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); packaging CC0.

items.title: Global Sanctions & Compliance Statistics 2026
items.content_text: Key statistics on global sanctions programs, enforcement actions, and compliance spending. Data from OFAC, UN, EU, FATF, and industry reports.
